lines.plainText: Hortensio to what end are all these words

lines.text: Sir, let me be so bold as ask you,
lines.plainText: Sir let me be so bold as ask you

lines.text: Did you yet ever see Baptista's daughter?
lines.plainText: Did you yet ever see Baptista's daughter

lines.text: No, sir, but hear I do that he hath two,
lines.plainText: No sir but hear I do that he hath two

lines.text: The one as famous for a scolding tongue
lines.plainText: The one as famous for a scolding tongue

lines.text: As is the other for beauteous modesty.
lines.plainText: As is the other for beauteous modesty

lines.text: Sir, sir, the first's for me; let her go by.
lines.plainText: Sir sir the first's for me let her go by

lines.text: Yea, leave that labour to great Hercules,
lines.plainText: Yea leave that labour to great Hercules

lines.text: And let it be more than Alcides' twelve.
lines.plainText: And let it be more than Alcides' twelve

lines.text: Sir, understand you this of me, in sooth:
lines.plainText: Sir understand you this of me in sooth

lines.text: The youngest daughter, whom you hearken for,
lines.plainText: The youngest daughter whom you hearken for

lines.text: Her father keeps from all access of suitors,
lines.plainText: Her father keeps from all access of suitors

lines.text: And will not promise her to any man
lines.plainText: And will not promise her to any man

lines.text: Until the elder sister first be wed;
lines.plainText: Until the elder sister first be wed

lines.text: The younger then is free, and not before.
lines.plainText: The younger then is free and not before

lines.text: If it be so, sir, that you are the man
lines.plainText: If it be so sir that you are the man

lines.text: Must stead us all, and me amongst the rest;
lines.plainText: Must stead us all and me amongst the rest

lines.text: And if you break the ice, and do this feat,
lines.plainText: And if you break the ice and do this feat

lines.text: Achieve the elder, set the younger free
lines.plainText: Achieve the elder set the younger free

lines.text: For our access, whose hap shall be to have her
lines.plainText: For our access whose hap shall be to have her

lines.text: Will not so graceless be to be ingrate.
lines.plainText: Will not so graceless be to be ingrate

lines.text: Sir, you say well, and well you do conceive;
lines.plainText: Sir you say well and well you do conceive

lines.text: And since you do profess to be a suitor,
lines.plainText: And since you do profess to be a suitor

lines.text: You must, as we do, gratify this gentleman,
lines.plainText: You must as we do gratify this gentleman

lines.text: To whom we all rest generally beholding.
lines.plainText: To whom we all rest generally beholding

lines.text: Sir, I shall not be slack; in sign whereof,
lines.plainText: Sir I shall not be slack in sign whereof

lines.text: Please ye we may contrive this afternoon,
lines.plainText: Please ye we may contrive this afternoon

lines.text: And quaff carouses to our mistress' health;
lines.plainText: And quaff carouses to our mistress' health

lines.text: And do as adversaries do in law,
lines.plainText: And do as adversaries do in law

lines.text: Strive mightily, but eat and drink as friends.
lines.plainText: Strive mightily but eat and drink as friends

lines.text: The motion's good indeed, and be it so:—
lines.plainText: The motion's good indeed and be it so

lines.text: Petruchio, I shall be your ben venuto.
lines.plainText: Petruchio I shall be your ben venuto
